name: LumbarSpineTriageAndPhenotyping
title: SpineAI Questionnaire
description: Triage and phenotyping questionnaire for lumbar spine conditions including axial back pain and radiculopathy.

valueExpression.name: caudaEquina
valueExpression.expression: %resource.descendants().where(linkId='1.6').answer.value.where(code='retention' or code='bladder-bowel' or code='perineal-numbness' or code='leg-weakness' or code='bilateral-weakness' or code='bilateral-numbness').exists()

valueExpression.name: cancer
valueExpression.expression: %resource.descendants().where(linkId='1.4').answer.value.where(code='373066001').exists() and %resource.descendants().where(linkId='1.4a' or linkId='1.4b' or linkId='1.4c' or linkId='1.4d').answer.value.where(code='373066001').exists()

valueExpression.name: legWeakness
valueExpression.expression: %caudaEquina.not() and %resource.descendants().where(linkId='1.1').answer.value.where(code='leg-pain' or code='trouble-walking' or code='mixed').exists() and %resource.descendants().where(linkId='7.5').answer.value.where(code='severe').exists()

Which option best describes your primary symptom?

item.text: How long have these symptoms been present?

Do you currently have any of the following new symptoms?

New numbness around the groin, buttocks or inner thighs

Do you currently have known metastatic disease involving your spine?

Please Have Your Symptoms Checked

Your answers include symptoms that should be checked by a clinician today, because they can point to pressure on the nerves at the base of the spine. Please tell the study coordinator about these symptoms now, and do not continue with the study for the moment. If your symptoms are severe or getting worse, call 911 or your local emergency number, or go to the nearest emergency department. Otherwise the study coordinator will help you find care and tell you how to proceed.

Please tell the study coordinator about these symptoms now, and do not continue with the study for the moment.
